name: iter_guided_wins_search
description: GUIDED-WINS SEARCH - the storyline's final act: under which combination of (a) weaker pretraining and (b) candidate scarcity do the four mix policies (Constant, Exponential dump x0.1 = 'guided round 1, random after', Adaptive severity, Adaptive size) turn recovery-to-parity into an actual across-the-loop guided win? Undertraining alone does NOT rescue constant mix (iter20_anchor_i3n50), so the bet is the interaction: a weak initial model leaves a deficit too large to fix in one round, a small per-round budget (n_select 30) heals it slowly, and a thinned pool (deficit 0.9 / 0.98 -> only ~40 / ~8 of 2000 candidates per round inside the gap) means uniform sampling almost never finds gap points while a guided kernel harvests them every round - a persistent informational advantage rather than a one-shot repair. deficit 0.0 is the control. New-only regime, warm-start, K=8, 5 seeds first pass.
